reference.exactEntityState: Living non-boss enemy species wraith; actual hand lantern at local (22.5,1.5), mirrored with facing and scaled for captains.
traitsToPreserve: Existing hooded spectral body and carried framed lantern remain unchanged.
Light follows the bobbed, mirrored lantern glass, not a floating extra fixture.
Small daylight bloom; 64-unit warm night pool and bright glass; keep in Optimization Mode.
No light for dead actors or unrelated stalkers/Archive boss bodies.
Future raster adaptation must retain the carried-glass anchor or supply an explicit replacement anchor.
Bound closest eight carried sources and retain the shared overall light budget; no AI/combat/save/light-visibility mechanics change.

proceduralOwnersAndReasons: Existing actor-facing projection and atmosphere light owner; no new simulation subsystem or sprite replacement.
